name: MyScale
tagline: Former SQL vector database forked from ClickHouse; the company shut down in 2025.
description: MyScale was a managed SQL vector database built on a fork of ClickHouse, adding its MSTG vector index, Tantivy-based full-text search and SQL functions for hybrid and filtered vector queries. The engine was open-sourced as MyScaleDB under Apache-2.0 in 2024. The company announced it was ceasing operations in April 2025 and closed in May 2025; the cloud console is offline and the repository has had no commits since February 2025. Existing users should migrate, typically to ClickHouse (which now has native vector similarity indexes) or a dedicated vector database.
statusNote: MyScale announced it was ceasing operations in April 2025 and closed in May 2025; the cloud service is offline and the MyScaleDB repo is inactive since Feb 2025. Migrate to ClickHouse vector indexes or a vector DB.

pricing.notes: The managed MyScale Cloud no longer operates; only the archived-in-practice open-source code remains.

strengths: Vector search combined with full ClickHouse SQL analytics
Filtered and hybrid search expressed in SQL
Columnar storage made metadata filters cheap
weaknesses: No security patches or releases since late 2024
Fork has diverged from upstream ClickHouse
useCases: Planning migrations of existing MyScale data to ClickHouse
notIdealFor: Production workloads needing support or security fixes
